faq: Can you build the store if I have no hosting yet?
Yes. We suggest hosts that suit a shop, you create the account and pay the host, then add us as a user. WordPress, WooCommerce and everything else live in your own hosting.
Which payment gateways can you connect?
Stripe, PayPal, Square and WooCommerce Payments are common. Availability depends on your country and business type, and you create the account with the provider yourself.
Can I import products from a spreadsheet?
Yes. Send a CSV or spreadsheet and your images and we import and tidy them. If you only have a supplier link, tell us before you order so we can confirm the best way.
Do I pay for themes and extensions?
Free ones are used where they work. If a paid extension is worth it, we tell you the price first, and you buy the licence in your own name.
desc:
Ecom Swift LLC handles WooCommerce store development from scratch: a new shop on your own hosting with theme, products, payments, shipping, tax and legal pages set up and tested with a real order.

## What does a WooCommerce store build involve?

A WooCommerce store build turns a blank WordPress install into a shop that can take a real order. The work covers the theme and branding, product entries with photos and options, a payment gateway, shipping zones, tax rules, the legal pages and a tested checkout. It ends with a store you own and can run without us.

## Why the setup decides how smoothly the shop runs

WooCommerce is flexible, which means almost nothing is decided for you. Hosting, theme, payment provider, shipping method and extensions are all choices, and weak early choices are hard to undo once orders arrive. A heavy theme, a dozen overlapping plugins or inconsistent product data will slow the store and complicate everything you add later.

A clean build starts with a short list of decisions: what you sell, where you ship, how you get paid and how the shop should look. With those answered, each setting has a reason.

## How the build supports conversions

Shoppers buy when the store feels clear and safe. That depends on pages loading quickly, product photos and variations that behave properly, shipping costs that appear before the final step and policy pages that explain returns and privacy. Branded order emails continue the same impression after the purchase.

A tested checkout matters most. A payment gateway that is connected but not tested, a tax rule that is missing for one region or a shipping zone with a gap can cost orders without any visible error. We complete a real test order so these faults show up before launch. How well the store sells afterward depends on your products, prices and traffic.

## What a ready-to-sell store includes

- A fast theme set up with your logo, colors and fonts.
- Products added with images, descriptions, categories and variations such as sizes or colors.
- A payment gateway connected and tested.
- Shipping zones and methods matching where you deliver.
- Tax settings that fit your region and product types.
- Terms, returns and privacy pages written as drafts for you to review.
- Coupons and sale prices set up where you need them.
- Branded order emails for customers and for you.
- Analytics, ad tracking, an abandoned-cart email flow and a speed and mobile check on the larger builds.

## How we work

We build on your own hosting, in your own WordPress admin, so you own the store from day one. After a short brief, we set up the theme and structure, add your products from the information you send, connect the payment gateway and configure shipping and tax.

You get a private preview before launch. We then run a full test order, go through a launch checklist with you and hand over a guide to managing the shop. The Basic package covers a branded working shop with your first products. Standard adds variations, custom home page sections, coupons, legal pages and branded emails. Premium covers a larger range, custom shop page design, email and tracking setup, a handover call and a period of follow-up fixes.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Choose reliable hosting that suits a store, not only a blog.
- Prepare product photos at consistent sizes and with clean backgrounds.
- Decide your shipping rules and return policy before the build starts.
- Keep the extension list short and give each one a purpose.
- Test checkout on a phone before you announce the launch.

**Avoid:**
- Buying a theme because of a demo you will never replicate.
- Adding products with missing weights, since shipping rates depend on them.
- Copying legal pages from another store without review.
- Launching before a test order has gone through every step.

## Who this is for

This service suits a new brand opening its first online shop, a local business that wants to sell beyond its area, and a seller moving from a marketplace to a store of their own. You can begin with only an idea, a product list and a hosting account.

## What we need from you

Send a short brief about your business, your logo and colors if you have them, and your product details in a spreadsheet or document. Give us an administrator user in your WordPress site, never your password. Themes and paid extensions, where used, are bought by you from their makers, and our price covers the work only.
